raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Restore MiDashengLM's historical untied decoder default when `text_config` omits `tie_word_embeddings`, while preserving explicit settings. Fixes #61469.

## Claims

- Load the checkpoint's independent output head instead of tying it to the input embedding.
- Preserve explicit `tie_word_embeddings=True` and `False` configurations.

## Validation

Independently reproduced the public report on one A100 40GB, BF16, TP=1, eager mode. Both vLLM arms used the official `77154ca61` cu129 nightly, Transformers 5.19.0, PyTorch 2.13.0+cu129, and model revision `64d40b767071414730dc9db21f1f97bcd1e4cc9c`. The config shim, model, Qwen2 decoder, and weight loader are byte-identical between that wheel's source and this PR's `429a3da6` base. The HF reference used the same checkpoint with Transformers 4.52.4.

| Check | Original vLLM | Patched vLLM | HF reference |
|---|---|---|---|
| Reported text prompt | Empty; 16 × token 151872 | `Four`, then stop | `Four`, then stop |
| 100-utterance WER | 100% (2346/2346) | 1.49% (35/2346) | 1.53% (36/2346) |
| Outputs containing undefined tokenizer IDs | 100/100 | 0/100 | 0/100 |
| Empty outputs | 70/100 | 0/100 | 0/100 |
| Outputs reaching the 128-token limit | 100/100 | 0/100 | 0/100 |

The audio set is the lexicographically first 100 utterance IDs from LibriSpeech test-clean, fixed before inference. All arms used identical audio hashes and prompt token IDs. This is a bounded regression evaluation, not the full benchmark. Patched vLLM and HF had 95/100 identical token sequences. Re-running the other five cases serially with stepwise top-10 gave one exact sequence and four passing the project's first-divergence mutual-top-k criterion. This does not establish bitwise equivalence or a quality improvement from the one-word WER difference.

The live weight probe found aliased embedding/head storage and a mismatching head checkpoint sample before the fix. Afterward, storage was independent and both samples matched their checkpoint keys. Model-loading memory increased from 14.52 to 15.53 GiB, consistent with retaining the independent head.

Repository checks against the real vLLM installation:
- New config regression: original 1 failed / 2 passed; patched all 3 passed.
- Full `tests/transformers_utils/test_config.py`: 20 passed, 1 failed due to HTTP 403 accessing a gated Llama repository (unrelated to this change).
- MiDashengLM registry: 1 passed; initialization: 1 passed; multimodal processing: 3 passed.
- Full `pre-commit run --files vllm/transformers_utils/configs/midashenglm.py tests/transformers_utils/test_config.py`: passed.

<details>
<summary>Test commands</summary>

The tests used the PR checkout's test files against the installed official wheel with only this config patch applied. In the GPU environment:

```bash
cd /root/contrib1015
export PYTHONPATH=/root/contrib1015/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages:/root/contrib1015/source
export HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/root/contrib1015/compat/usr/local/cuda-12.9/compat:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
.venv/bin/python -m pytest source/tests/transformers_utils/test_config.py -k midashenglm --import-mode=importlib -v
.venv/bin/python -m pytest source/tests/transformers_utils/test_config.py --import-mode=importlib -v
.venv/bin/python -m pytest source/tests/models/test_registry.py -k MiDashengLMModel --import-mode=importlib -v
.venv/bin/python -m pytest source/tests/models/test_initialization.py -k MiDashengLMModel --import-mode=importlib -v
.venv/bin/python -m pytest source/tests/models/multimodal/processing/test_common.py -k midashenglm --import-mode=importlib -v
```

The first command was run on the original config; the full file and model checks were run after the patch. The old host driver used NVIDIA's official CUDA 12.9 compatibility libraries. The minimal generation reproducer is the text-only example in #61469, with the pinned checkpoint above.

</details>

## Details

The checkpoint omits `tie_word_embeddings`. Transformers moved the Qwen2.5-Omni untied default from the text config to its outer thinker config in huggingface/transformers#41541. MiDashengLM directly embeds the text config and consequently inherits the tied default. vLLM's Qwen2 decoder then aliases its head to the input embedding, and the loader skips the independent output-head tensor.

The fix supplies the historical default in the MiDashengLM config shim only. No shared Qwen2, RoPE, or loader behavior changes.

Rechecked #61469's comments/timeline, the complete open-PR title inventory, and related open/closed searches before submission. #61470 adds tower/connector LoRA and explicitly leaves this base-model issue unresolved; it does not contain this configuration fix.

AI assistance was used for investigation, implementation, and validation. This work follows a public issue and an independent reproduction; it is not presented as the submitter's production experience.

---

files.patch:
@@ -27,6 +27,21 @@
 from vllm.transformers_utils.configs.mistral import adapt_config_dict
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tie_word_embeddings", [None, False, True])
+def test_midashenglm_preserves_decoder_weight_tying(tie_word_embeddings):
+    from vllm.transformers_utils.configs.midashenglm import MiDashengLMConfig
+
+    text_config = {"vocab_size": 152064}
+    if tie_word_embeddings is not None:
+        text_config["tie_word_embeddings"] = tie_word_embeddings
+
+    config = MiDashengLMConfig(text_config=text_config)
+
+    # Published checkpoints omit the flag and have independent decoder weights.
+    expected = False if tie_word_embeddings is None else tie_word_embeddings
+    assert config.text_config.tie_word_embeddings is expected
+
+
 @pytest.mark.parametrize("layout", ["mixed", "flat"])
 def test_gemma4_dspark_rope_config_preserves_parameters(tmp_path, layout):
     """Remove redundant shared entries while preserving per-layer and flat RoPE."""

@@ -93,11 +93,8 @@ def __init__(
     ):
         self.audio_encoder_config = DashengConfig(**(audio_encoder_config or {}))
         self.subsample_factor = subsample_factor
-        self.text_config = (
-            Qwen2_5OmniTextConfig(**text_config)
-            if text_config
-            else Qwen2_5OmniTextConfig()
-        )
+        text_config = {"tie_word_embeddings": False, **(text_config or {})}
+        self.text_config = Qwen2_5OmniTextConfig(**text_config)
         self.text_config.rope_parameters = None  # uses_mrope is false
         self.audio_token_id = audio_token_id
         super().__init__(**kwargs)
